caseNameFull: Harry A. Horine v. United States
summary: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Harry A. Horine and Mr. Sam Goslinsky for petitioners. No brief filed for the United States.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for a writ of certiorari herein, without a certified copy of the record, granted, the case docketed, and the petition denied.
